benefits.title: Free from admin chaos
benefits.subtitle: Kashkol is built around every problem you face daily — not just another data storage app.

attendance.title: Attendance & Roll Call
attendance.body: Save 30 minutes every class. Mark attendance with a scan, and generate a parent-ready absence report in seconds.
attendance.problem: 15-25 minutes of every class is wasted on paper roll calls and students disputing their attendance records.
attendance.solution: 1-tap digital roster + QR scan 60 students in 60 seconds + instant WhatsApp absence report.

parents.title: Parent Portal
parents.body: Give every student a secure link showing real-time attendance, homework, and grades. Cut parent messages by 70%.
parents.problem: Parents flood your phone with the same questions day and night: Did my son attend? What was his grade?
parents.solution: A private parent portal installed as an app on their phone answers every question automatically, 24/7.

homework.title: Homework & Academic Performance
homework.body: Track who submitted and who did not, record grades, and spot struggling students early — without a single spreadsheet.
homework.problem: You only realize a student stopped submitting homework when they fail the monthly exam — too late to intervene.
homework.solution: Per-session homework tracking, live performance cards, and early-warning alerts for at-risk students.

payments.title: Fees & Payments
payments.body: Eliminate payment confusion. See every student balance, calculate session revenue, and track outstanding fees in seconds.
payments.problem: Tracking monthly fees, booklet costs, center commissions, and overdue balances in paper notebooks causes financial leakage.
payments.solution: An audit-proof cash ledger per student showing who paid, who owes, and the total revenue for every session.

team.title: Team & Assistants
team.body: Add assistants with safe, limited permissions. Every change is timestamped with their name, keeping your finances private.
team.problem: Giving assistants access to your account exposes your financial data and all group information to everyone.
team.solution: Role-based permissions so assistants can take attendance without seeing financial numbers or other groups.

files.title: Files & Study Materials
files.body: Upload revision sheets, model answers, and booklets once. Students find everything organized in their portal.
files.problem: PDF model answers get buried in WhatsApp groups and students cannot find last week revision sheets.
files.solution: A session-linked file library that is securely accessible only to students enrolled in that specific group.

proof.title: A product that earns confidence
proof.subtitle: Kashkol is designed to be clear, reliable, and respectful of your work and your students' data.

records.title: Clear, dependable records
records.body: The numbers you see come from the records you keep, so you always know where they came from.

arabic.title: Made for Arabic and English
arabic.body: Use Kashkol in Arabic or English, with the right direction and a polished experience in both.

privacy.title: Your workspace stays yours
privacy.body: Each workspace is separate, with access handled carefully so your data stays in the right place.

how.title: Three steps to start
how.subtitle: No complex setup, and no mandatory import.

workspace.title: Create your workspace
workspace.body: Your name, subject, timezone, and currency. Isolated from day one.

roster.title: Add students and groups
roster.body: Start from scratch or import your roster, then organise students into groups.

day.title: Run your day
day.body: Take attendance, assign homework, and review submissions.

faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Clear answers before you get started.

start.question: How fast can I get started?
start.answer: You can create your workspace, add students and groups, and start running your day right away. Start simple and build as you go.

language.question: Can I use Kashkol in Arabic and English?
language.answer: Yes. Kashkol works in Arabic and English, with the right direction and a great experience in both.

records.question: Can I trust the numbers I see?
records.answer: Yes. The dashboard and reports are based on the records you keep in Kashkol, so your information stays clear and consistent.

support.question: Is Kashkol built for private teachers?
support.answer: Yes. Kashkol is designed around the real daily workflow of private teachers — students, groups, sessions, attendance, homework, and assessments.

cta.title: Ready to run your teaching practice with confidence?
